asset: Traditional Hokkaido kibori-kuma bear biting salmon v19 — genuine Harness GLB
reviewer: ChatGPT direct visual inspection of v19 four-view Blender Cycles renders exported from official 3DCodeVerse Harness GLB; not AI-generated images

bear_anatomy_and_silhouette.reason: Broad shoulders and shorter torso remain an improvement from earlier iterations, but face-to-body proportions are stylized and legs still look tubular.

face_and_expression.reason: Helmet-like forehead, applied ears and eye details; nose is too smooth and large, and the muzzle does not naturally wrap the fish.

salmon_shape_and_bite.reason: The v19 shorter lower jaw removes the obvious projecting lower tray, but fish still looks like a flat tan plank pressed under the nose. Upper and lower contact is not anatomically legible.

carving_detail_and_wood.reason: Repeating rounded ripple impressions across torso; smooth waxy surface rather than irregular directional hand-carved facets and dark wood grain.

paws_and_limbs.reason: Paws remain wide sock-like columns with superficial toe slits and weak claw integration.

multi_view_presentation.reason: Genuine four-view front, three-quarter, rear-side and top Cycles renders are complete and clear enough to identify problems.

defects.finding: Shortened mandible no longer protrudes as a tray, but it is mostly hidden behind fish and the fish still reads as held below the nose rather than between upper and lower teeth/lips.
defects.required_fix: Rebuild the fish-bite contact as a continuous sculptural cheek, muzzle, and jaw envelope with visible contact in profile and front view; avoid simply adding more lines or floating geometry.

defects.finding: Eyes and ears are still attached-looking spheres, with little eye socket or brow anatomy.
defects.required_fix: Carve integrated eye hollows, shorten the nose bridge, transition the cheek to skull with one continuous mesh.

defects.finding: Torso shows regular ripples and soft waxy material, not hand-carved wood.
defects.required_fix: Replace periodic embossing with irregular anisotropic shallow V-cut geometry following shoulder and flank hair direction; verify against actual renders.

defects.finding: Feet still read as cylindrical boots with tiny scratches rather than integrated toes and nails.
defects.required_fix: Reprofile front paws with organic flattened palm, embedded toes and low triangular nails.

improvement_tasks: v19 geometry patch successfully built and rendered; technical success does not imply artistic acceptance.
Retain the shortened mandible as a modest improvement; next pass should focus on integrated facial anatomy and bite silhouette, not repeated micro-adjustment to lip curves.
Keep v19 candidate only. The fail-closed gate must reject this review because mean score is below 4 and blocker/critical defects remain.
